description: County cadastral map showing towns (townships), numbered town survey divisions, irregular rural property tracts, rural buildings, and rural householders' names. The Rochester and Brockport insets show buildings and city wards; the smaller insets show buildings and householders' names. Hand colored to emphasize town (township) boundaries. "Entered according to Act of Congress in the year 1858 by Robert Pearsall Smith in the ... the eastern District of Pennsylvania." Originally printed on 4 sheets (later conjoined to form 2 sheets [northern/southern] on cloth backing). LC sheets imperfect: Darkened at edges, additionally fold-lined, sectioned to 2 sheets each folding to 3 vertical panels. Includes distance table, local business directories, 35 village/city insets, and illustrations of prominent buildings. LC Land ownership maps, 519 Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. 2 copies

description: This record covers single maps covering counties of New York, which are not represented in the LC database by separate catalog records. This collection includes single printed maps and photocopies of printed or manuscript single maps and may also include some multi-sheet single maps, plates from atlases, books or periodicals, and printed facsimiles. These maps may also show various subjects, such as roads, topography, geology, hydrology, and recreation and tourism. To request a specific map or for more information, contact a reference librarian in the Geography & Map Division (202) 707-6277 or through the "Ask a librarian" link through the Geography & Map Division website https://ask.loc.gov/map-geography/.
